Sample: 1A 
Score: 9 

The response earned all 9 points. 

Sample: 1B 
Score: 6 

The response earned 6 points: 2 points in part (a), 2 points in part (b), no points in part (c), and 2 points in part (d). 
In parts (a) and (b), the student’s work is correct. In part (c) the student works with ( )
